---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement and explain the problem it solves
title: "[Feature] "
---

## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation, who it affects, and an example of when it occurs.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result you would like to see from a user's perspective.

## Alternatives

Describe any workarounds or other approaches you considered.

## Scope and context

Mention relevant platforms, formats, or workflows. Add screenshots or mockups if useful, without personal or sensitive information.

## Checks

- [ ] I searched existing issues for similar requests.
- [ ] I checked the project's scope and non-goals in the [design plan](https://github.com/irfanadwifangga/yt-to-mp3/blob/main/docs/yt-to-mp3-go-planning.md).

If this request would change a non-goal, explain why that scope should be reconsidered.
